description: x402 Conformance Suite: Batch conformance and compliance check for up to 10 x402 endpoints in one call, made for CI: every URL is checked for a real 402, decodable challenge, complete accepts[], placeholder input examples and the 8,190 B header limit, and the response is one machine-readable pass/fail list (tally + finding codes) a pipeline can gate on. Answers "are all my endpoints still payable?" after a deploy.
name: x402-conformance-suite
